title: See workers' licences for high-risk work
what: Not direct or allow a worker to do high-risk work that needs a licence (such as crane or forklift operation, scaffolding, or dogging and rigging) without seeing written evidence of the worker's licence.

laws.title: Work Health and Safety (National Uniform Legislation) Regulations 2011 (NT)

sources.title: Work Health and Safety (National Uniform Legislation) Regulations 2011 (NT)
sources.locator: Evidence of licence – duty of person conducting business or undertaking, subreg (1) (current reprint)
sources.quote: (1) A person conducting a business or undertaking at a workplace must not direct or allow a worker to carry out high risk work for which a high risk work licence is required unless the person sees written evidence provided by the worker that the worker has the relevant high risk work licence for that work.

administration.note: Issues the high-risk work licences the business must check, and enforces the duty.

sources.title: Work Health and Safety (National Uniform Legislation) Act 2011 (NT)
sources.locator: s 1, words naming the body (found 12 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: regulator means the Work Health Authority.

triggers.note: When a worker is to do a class of high-risk work listed in the regulation's Schedule 3.

reach.condition: if its workers do high-risk work that needs a licence (such as operating cranes or forklifts, scaffolding, or dogging and rigging)
reach.note: Any business whose workers do licensed high-risk work, in any industry; most often construction, manufacturing, mining, transport and warehousing.

assessment.summary: A business must not let a worker do high-risk work (such as operating cranes or forklifts, scaffolding, or dogging and rigging) without seeing the worker's licence. Only licensed workers can be hired for that work.

marks.reason: Only licensed workers may do high-risk work, which narrows who can be hired for it.

assessment.confidence_note: Marked from the duty's design against the framework's guide; the safety benefit is not counted by the framework.
